facts.anchor: she had to go to the bathroom and recompose herself after the bedroom scene
facts.fact: 看完卧室那场戏，Saskia 不得不去洗手间平复自己。

facts.anchor: It reminds her that she has to keep herself separate
facts.fact: 口罩提醒 Saskia：她必须把自己与 Lucy 隔开，不能靠得更近。

facts.anchor: After Jennifer’s Body, Lucy asks her if she’s seen Scream
facts.fact: 《Jennifer’s Body》放完后，Lucy 问 Saskia 有没有看过《Scream》。

facts.anchor: now she slumps down a little, stretches her legs out onto the coffee table
facts.fact: 看《Scream》时 Lucy 往下瘫坐、把腿伸到咖啡桌上，两人间距从五英尺缩到约三英尺。

facts.anchor: She won’t let anyone else hurt her.
facts.fact: Saskia 意识到 Lucy 从未被吻过、极易受伤，决心不让任何人伤害她。

facts.anchor: Lucy lays down so that her head is on the throw pillow
facts.fact: Lucy 躺下，把头枕在沙发角落的抱枕上，脚抵着 Saskia 的腿睡着了。

facts.anchor: Saskia tips her head against the arm of the couch, and—
facts.fact: Saskia 本想抽身回自己公寓，但太困，头靠沙发扶手睡了过去。
Saskia 醒来时手里握着一把刀（本章结尾）。
